report:
Breast, right, wide local excision

The specimen consists of a right wide local excision specimen (48 g, 60 x 45 x 30 mm). Sectioning reveals an ill-defined, stellate, gritty area measuring 22 mm in greatest dimension (22 x 15 x 10 mm) in the upper outer quadrant (10 o'clock, 40 mm from the nipple), 8 mm from the anterior margin. The remaining breast tissue is fibrofatty and unremarkable.

(1-6) lesion and biopsy site with the anterior margin.
(7-11) posterior, superior, inferior, medial and lateral margins.
(12-14) remaining breast.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Excision (less than total mastectomy)
- Specimen laterality: Right
- Tumour site: Upper outer quadrant (10 o'clock, 40 mm from the nipple)
- Number of blocks with DCIS out of total: 5 of 14 blocks

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS)
- Size (extent) of DCIS: Greatest dimension 22 mm (22 x 15 x 10 mm)
- Architectural patterns: Cribriform, Solid
- Nuclear grade: Grade II (intermediate)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show ductal carcinoma in situ of intermediate grade with cribriform
  and solid architecture, with focal necrosis and associated microcalcification,
  spanning 22 mm (5 of 14 blocks). No invasive carcinoma is identified.
- Necrosis: Present, focal (small foci or single cell necrosis)
- Microcalcifications: Present in DCIS
- Nipple: Not present in specimen
- Additional lesions: Not identified

Ancillary studies
- Biomarker studies: Reported on the prior core biopsy (S26-02345): ER positive
  (95%, strong), PR positive (80%, strong)

Margins (DCIS)
- Anterior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: 3 mm
- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: 6 mm
- Superior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Inferior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Medial margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Lateral margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: 5 mm

Regional lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: No lymph nodes submitted or found

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pTis(DCIS) pNX

Additional findings
- None

- DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU, intermediate grade, 22 mm; margins clear (closest
